name: tiergear
description: A decision model picks the model and reasoning effort for each session and adjusts effort as the work changes.

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: Decision model preset: jev, laya or kev.

judgeBaseUrl.title: Judge base URL
judgeBaseUrl.description: Leave unset for the preset's address. Must be https, or http to localhost.

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Leave unset for the preset's model.

judgeApiKey.title: Judge API key
judgeApiKey.description: Leave unset to use the preset's environment variable (TYPESAFE_API_KEY, OLLAYA_API_KEY, KEV_API_KEY), which is sent only to the preset's own address.

switchModelMidSession.title: Switch model mid-session
switchModelMidSession.description: After the first turn, also change the model (loses the whole prompt cache; an effort change usually keeps it). Off: only effort changes.

instantSwitchConfidence.title: Confidence · instant switch
instantSwitchConfidence.description: A lower tier the judge is at least this sure of applies at once, skipping 'Turns to lower'. Leave unset (or 0) to turn it off.

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence · lower
minDowngradeConfidence.description: Minimum judge confidence for a turn to count toward lowering the tier.

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence · raise
minUpgradeConfidence.description: Minimum judge confidence to raise the tier.

stuckConfidence.title: Confidence · stuck
stuckConfidence.description: Judge stuck probability that raises the tier one step.

downgradeStreak.title: Turns to lower
downgradeStreak.description: Consecutive confident turns needed before lowering one step.

stuckFailures.title: Repeated failures
stuckFailures.description: Identical tool failures in a row that raise the tier one step.

firstTurnTimeoutMs.title: First-turn latency budget (ms)
firstTurnTimeoutMs.description: Leave unset for the preset's value. At most 8000.

turnTimeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
turnTimeoutMs.description: Leave unset for the preset's value. At most 8000.

showRecentButton.title: Show Recent button
showRecentButton.description: Show the [ Recent ] button above the prompt. Off: /tiergear still opens the pane.

showPrefix.title: Show tiergear prefix
showPrefix.description: Start the band above the prompt with 'tiergear ·'.

showStatusText.title: Show status text
showStatusText.description: Show the line's tier, confidence, model/effort and reason above the prompt (each has its own option too). Turn off if a status line tool shows them (tiergear status).

showTier.title: Show tier
showTier.description: Show the tier in the line above the prompt.

showConfidence.title: Show confidence
showConfidence.description: Show the judge's confidence in the line above the prompt.

showModelEffort.title: Show model/effort
showModelEffort.description: Show the model and effort in effect in the line above the prompt.

showReason.title: Show reason
showReason.description: Show why nothing changed, as 'unchanged (same tier)', in the line above the prompt.

showFloor.title: Show floor
showFloor.description: Show the floor picker above the prompt; tiers under the floor are struck through and can't be picked.

showTierButtons.title: Show tier buttons
showTierButtons.description: Show the manual and tier buttons above the prompt.
